design_intent.anti_overfit: R1.3 rules are frozen before any R1.3 OOS replay. R1.2 OOS is treated as diagnosis only, not as a tuning surface.
design_intent.primary: Increase early trend participation and MCR without weakening structural loss control.

IGNITION.purpose: Participate when trend ignition is confirmed before a full retest, while preventing chase.
IGNITION.structural_stop_rule: Local 1H structure: prior3 opposite swing with 0.25*H1 ATR invalidation buffer, mirrored by direction

RETEST.structural_stop_rule: R1.2 zone/0.45ATR reference +0.35ATR buffer, mirrored by direction

hard_execution_gates.severe_risk_veto: BLOCK when confirmed; N/A historical severe-event reconstruction cannot be silently treated as PASS

oos_policy.historical_r13_replay_after_freeze: May be run for diagnostics but is not untouched promotion evidence because R1.3 design was motivated by R1.2 OOS diagnosis.
oos_policy.promotion_evidence_note: Forward untouched OOS is the clean promotion evidence. 30D/90D/365D labels mature only when their horizons are complete.

predeclared_validation_gates.exact_v2_6_h2h: Still required by current governance; if exact baseline remains non-replayable, status remains UNRESOLVED rather than using a proxy.

false_start_control.definition: Confirmed false start / executed first-1H-entry episodes with complete 90D truth

predeclared_validation_gates.robustness: Same predeclared Step8 battery concept; no best-variant adoption.

score_monotonicity.rule: Do not force PASS/FAIL when sample insufficient; otherwise higher score bins must not have lower mean R than lower bins.

risk_state.BLOCK: TRANSITION_CONFLICT or confirmed Severe Risk Veto. No entry route allowed.
risk_state.CAUTION: Legacy FALSE_BOTTOM_RISK/FALSE_TOP_RISK/long_overextended/short_overextended present, but no transition conflict.
risk_state.OPEN: No transition conflict and no legacy caution flag.
